title: S1, after-rain patrol
summary: Simulated. A heavy-rain reading at JPS station 27880 queues a patrol of three lake segments. The dock holds through the rain and the thunderstorm warning, then launches in the next dry window once the pilot records the footway and segment 10's path clear. Edge Watch reports fence panel 4 missing by the playground path, a Tier 2 candidate, and the segment's pass is suspended. The manager confirms it in the Inbox and the crew puts up interim protection.

events.note: 05:30 local, 21 Oct: 40 mm/h at the Sungai Buloh station after a night of storms. The manager asks for a patrol of the S1 segment and two neighbours; the planner returns plan_1, held for the weather until the next dry morning (06:36 on 22 Oct) and for people on the footway.
The remote pilot approves plan_1. Approval does not lift a hold: the dock still waits for the weather.
06:36 local, 22 Oct: the morning is dry. The pilot sees the lakeside footway by the dock clear and records it, so take-off can go ahead.
The pilot records segment 10's path clear too, so the drone need not wait there.
The pilot starts patrol ptl_1: the simulated drone takes off from the roof dock. It photographs each segment's fixed viewpoints (obs_1, obs_2 on segment 12) and lands at 06:41:51.

body.rationale: Fence panel 4 is missing by the playground path

events.note: 06:42: Edge Watch compares viewpoint 2 with its baseline and reports fence panel 4 missing, a Tier 2 candidate (cand_1). A missing safety item suspends pass_866518980_11 at once.
07:05: the manager compares the photos in the Inbox and confirms it. Core opens finding fnd_1, interim protection task task_1 and draft work order wo_1.
07:40: the crew puts up a temporary barrier at the gap and closes task_1. The pass stays suspended until a repair is proven.
